questions.question_prompt: A light lorry has no trailer. Which maximum speed generally applies?
questions.keyed_answer: The speed limit of the road, subject to safe adaptation.
questions.teaching_excerpt: Without a trailer, it normally follows the road's maximum speed; the general heavy-lorry cap does not apply. A heavy lorry exceeds 3,500 kg: without a trailer its vehicle maximum is 90 km/h on a motorway or expressway, and 80 km/h on other roads; with a trailer it is 80 km/h. A lower road limit always applies. For a light lorry towing, check the combination rules in M08-L02. Transportstyrelsen: light and heavy lorries Apply the limit. A light lorry without a trailer on a road signed 100 km/h does not acquire an 80 km/h cap simply because it is called a lorry. Still reduce speed for visibility, grip, traffic and load; a maximum is not a target. Safe-speed duty, chapter 3 §14
questions.coverage_reasoning: Explains light-lorry ≤3500 kg road-maximum treatment without trailer, contrast with heavy-lorry caps, lower road limits, safe adaptation and towing exception; includes signed-100 example.

sources.scope_limits: Light-lorry statement explicitly scoped to no trailer. Lower road limit still binds heavy lorry; towing light lorry needs M08-L02 combination check. No inference that light lorry towing may always use road maximum.

questions.question_prompt: A trailer presses too heavily down on the towball. What can happen?
questions.keyed_answer: The car's front axle can be unloaded, impairing steering grip.
questions.teaching_excerpt: excessive downward force acts through a lever arm: it increases rear loading while reducing the load carried by the front axle. Front unloading does not require the wheels to leave the road. With less front-tyre loading, available steering grip and response can be impaired. Official towing guide: front-wheel unloading, page 6 Trafikverket warns that incorrect coupling pressure can lift the car or trailer. Follow the specified towball, coupling, axle and vehicle limits for the actual combination; there is no universal number in this lesson. Measure and redistribute the load as instructed before travelling. Total trailer weight, coupling load and cargo securing are separate checks. Do not cure excessive downward load by guessing or creating an equally unsuitable load distribution. Trafikverket: coupling-load caution · Official towing guide: ratings and load distribution Worked loading decision. Your total trailer weight is within the car's towing limit, but a heavy object far forward makes the coupling load excessive. The total-weight check has not proved suitable axle loading. Stop preparation, establish the specified limits and adjust and secure the load before driving.
questions.coverage_reasoning: Defines coupling force distinct from total trailer weight; rear coupling leverage unloads front axle and impairs steering grip. Explains not necessarily lifting wheels off road, actual limits and forward-load example.

sources.scope_limits: Agency safety background; does not state exact front-axle unloading/steering-grip mechanism or universal numeric towball limit.

sources.locator: If You Already Have a Tow Vehicle, printed page 6 / PDF page 8; definitions/ratings pp.4–6
sources.scope_limits: Conventional rear towball/coupling load explanation, not fifth-wheel geometry. No US percentage, hitch modification recipe, numeric load limit, registration or towing law imported. Front unloading means reduced axle load, not necessarily wheels leaving the road.

questions.question_prompt: What normally happens if the required inspection deadline is missed?
questions.keyed_answer: An automatic driving ban applies until the inspection requirements are addressed.
questions.teaching_excerpt: an automatic driving ban (inträtt körförbud) applies. You remain responsible even without a reminder. Booking a later appointment does not end the ban. The deadline ban lasts until the inspection has been carried out; follow its result, since defects can bring a new prohibition or a repair/reinspection requirement. Check the vehicle record before ordinary use. Transportstyrelsen: missed inspection · Vehicle Regulation, chapter 6 §§15–21 Restricted trips. With an overdue-inspection ban and on-road status (påställd), only the shortest suitable route to a repair workshop for repair or to an inspection business for inspection is permitted. If the vehicle is off-road (avställd) and the ban still applies, the exception is the shortest suitable route to the nearest inspection business. Traffic insurance and other applicable requirements still matter; the off-road exception requires no unpaid vehicle taxes. It does not permit errands or commuting. A prohibition issued because the vehicle is dangerously defective has different conditions: it must be recovered from the place where that prohibition is issued. Transportstyrelsen: inspection prohibitions · Transportstyrelsen: off-road inspection conditions Worked deadline. An ordinary light car's recorded inspection deadline is 31 October 2026. Without the required inspection, the deadline ban starts on 1 November. An appointment on 5 November does not allow normal driving on 2 November. Arrange a permitted inspection trip, or transport if it cannot be driven safely and lawfully, then follow the inspection result. These dates illustrate the rule; use the actual vehicle's record.
